title: BLR CSP scope
statement: Let $x$ and $y$ be functions from an $n$-element index set to the field with two elements. The scope of their BLR constraint is the ordered tuple of variables used by that constraint: it consists of the zero function alone if $x=0$, $y=0$, or $x=y$, and otherwise consists of $x$, $y$, and $x+y$, in that order.
hypotheses_covered: Two functions from an $n$-element index set to the field with two elements
